business_summary: Shenzhen Jieshun Science and Technology Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides parking operation services in China and internationally. It operates through four segments: Smart Hardware Business, Software and Cloud Services Business, Smart Parking Operation Business, and Parking Asset Operation Business. The company offers parking control machine, lot gate, auxiliary accessories, and payment machine; parking guidance and management, as well as smart lighting; and parking management system and smart parking space product solutions. It also provides facial recognition access control, AI visitor machine, access control card reader and controller, and integrated and embedded access control; intelligent swing gate, smart wing gate, and tripod turnstile; and access control management system, pedestrian walkway, and visitor management product solutions. In addition, the company offers smart charging pile and smart energy storage products; and slow charging station scenario, DC fast charging pile scenario, and public supercharging station product solutions, as well as charging parking space management plan. Further, it provides Tianqi platforms; mobile applications; and operation services, industry, and scenario solutions. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
